shortBio.en: Alice in Chains guitarist and songwriter; harmony vocals with Staley, then the post-2006 front line with DuVall.
shortBio.zh: Alice in Chains 吉他手与写歌人；与 Staley 和声，2006 年后与 DuVall 分担主唱线。

body.en:
Born 1966. Co-founder of Alice in Chains. Writes much of the catalog from Facelift through Dirt and beyond. After Staley’s death he continues with William DuVall.

Guitar and twin-vocal arrangements sit at the center of the band’s records.
body.zh:
1966 年生。Alice in Chains 联合创始人。从《Facelift》到《Dirt》及之后大量写歌。Staley 去世后与 William DuVall 继续。

吉他与双人声编排是乐队唱片的核心。
